page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal notes in the left margin. Running head at the top, page number at the top left, catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: fuerint, quæ luperest,ultima erit.Hoc te- porum tractu mirum est quantum inva- luerit religio Christiana. Tum siquidem Hierosolyma horrens ruinis, frequentis- simis ac magnificentissimis ecclesiis est adornata. Namq; Helena,mater principis An Chri- stî 315.Constantini,quæ Augusta cum filio con- regnabat, cum Hierosolymam agnoscere concupisceret, reperta ibi idola ac tem- pla protrivit: mox usa regni viribus, ba- silicam in loco Dominicæ passionis & re- surrectionis & ascensionis constituit, illud mirū, quod locus ille,in quo postre- mum initiierant divina vestigia, cum in vestigia Christi.cœlum Dominus nube sublatus est, con- tinuari pavimeto cum reliqua stratorum parte non potuit. Siquidem quæcunque applicabantur, insolens humana suscipe- re terra refpueret, excusis in ora appo- nentium sæpe marmoribus: quinetiam calcati Deo pulveris adeo perenne docu- mentum est, ut vestigia impressa cernan- Ambrof. in orat.de tur. Et cum quotidie confluentium fides obitu The.cerratim Domino calcata diripiat, dam- num tamen arena non sentiat: & eadem adhuc sui speciem, velut impressis signa- ta vestigiis,terra custodit. Ejusdem regi- næ

page.notes: The marginal note "Ambrof. in orat.de obitu The." is cut short at the page edge; the abbreviation after "The" is not fully legible and is given as printed. Two words of the note "An Chri- stî 315." are split across lines as printed. The reading "con- regnabat" is a line-end hyphenation. "Hierosolyma" is transcribed from the printed "Hierofolyma" with long s normalised. Catchword "næ" is at the bottom right.
